text:
marta: quick follow-up on console authz: im leaning toward a tiny policy sidecar + local cache, rather than many inline checks. reduces drift.
devin: sidecar + cache makes sense. main risk is p99 tail. what SLO should we target?
zhou: target p99 < 150ms for decision path so render tail stays intact. local cache must hit ~98% to meet that.
marta: sketch: local LRU per process with short TTL (2-5s), policy sidecar for misses, and an embed mode (WASM) for on-prem. policy bundle carries version + signature.
devin: WASM for private installs is neat. ensure policy language is declarative only (no external calls). keep eval cost O(1).
zhou: add coalescing for concurrent misses to avoid stampede; also include per-instance in-flight map. metrics: cache_hit, remote_calls, eval_latency_ms.
infra-bot: infra-bot: note added: require HA sidecar pattern and client-side circuit breaker + fallback. created ticket INFRA-2021.
marta: fallback semantics must be explicit: route manifest should declare degrade behavior (deny|allow|soft-allow+audit). product to decide defaults per-risk class.
devin: decision API proto minimal example: POST /v1/decide {tenant, route, attributes} -> {outcome, id, policy_version, ttl_ms, reason}. include trace_id.
zhou: also emit decision_id to logs so we can map user incidents to policy changes. very helpful for forensics.
marta: action items: marta -> prototype cache+coalescing; devin -> draft wasm embed flow + signing; zhou -> perf model + synthetic load. infra-bot: add HA checklist.
devin: will also add dry-run management API so authors can validate changes offline before pushing.
marta: ok will draft RFC follow-up with perf targets and rollout steps. thanks! :+1:
